items.title: Oil change, tire rotation and multi-point inspection
items.why: Do it when the dash shows OIL CHANGE REQUIRED, and never go past 1 year or 16 000 km. Includes rotating tires and checking brakes, cooling system, exhaust, steering, suspension and front axle U-joints. Ford expects the message every 8 000–12 000 km with towing, heavy loads, idling or extended cold. Reset the oil-life monitor after.

items.title: Engine air filter
items.why: Replace sooner on dusty or gravel roads.

items.title: Spark plugs
items.why: Ford's normal interval. If you tow often or idle a lot, Ford says every 96 000 km.

items.title: Engine coolant replacement
items.why: First change at 6 years or 160 000 km, then every 3 years or 80 000 km.

items.title: Accessory drive belt
items.why: Replace at 240 000 km. Inspect it at 160 000 km, then at every other oil change.

items.title: Axle and transfer case fluids
items.why: Front axle and transfer case on 4x4, rear axle on all. Change right away if the truck has been in deep water.

name: 2018 Ford F-150 2.7L EcoBoost
note: Oil changes follow the truck's oil-life monitor. The other items are fixed distances; Ford says to do them within 4 800 km of the oil change closest to the interval.
source: Ford 2018 F-150 Owner's Manual, Canada/US edition (Scheduled Maintenance, p. 563–572)

items.title: Oil and filter change
items.why: Severe driving (extreme cold, repeated short trips): every 3 months or 4 800 km. 0W-20 synthetic.

items.title: Rotate and inspect tires
items.why: Replace a tire when the tread wear bars show (1.6 mm left).

items.title: Brake, steering and suspension inspection
items.why: Brake pads, discs and lines, parking brake, axle boots and joints, steering, suspension, differential oil. With road salt or extreme cold: every 6 months or 9 600 km.

items.title: Cabin air filter
items.why: Called the HVAC/A/C filter in the booklet.

items.title: Engine air filter
items.why: Check more often on dusty roads.

items.title: Brake fluid replacement
items.why: In humid or mountainous areas: every 15 months or 24 000 km.

items.title: Inspect belts, fuel lines, cooling system and CVT fluid
items.why: Inspection only. Subaru replaces CVT fluid only under severe use or frequent towing (every 40 000 km); use Subaru CVT fluid only.

items.title: Spark plugs
items.why: Wheel bearings get inspected at the same interval.

items.title: Engine coolant replacement
items.why: Subaru Super Coolant. First change at 11 years or 220 000 km, then every 6 years or 120 000 km. Add Subaru Cooling System Conditioner when replacing.

name: 2019 Subaru Forester 2.5i
note: Normal intervals shown. Subaru counts extremely cold weather, road salt and repeated short trips as severe driving; the notes on each item give the severe interval.
